Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.concurrency (Drone concurrency.limit is a count and the IR models a group and cancel-in-progress, not a limit)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.runner: workers the operator provides (register a Drone runner with DRONE_RUNNER_LABELS=ubuntu-latest:true for the runner labels)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
